target_label: the process that caused this event
note: On a non-process event (DnsRequest, file, registry...), ContextProcessId identifies the process that caused it. This is how you attribute activity to a process.
The OS-visible PID. NOT unique over time -- PIDs are recycled. Never join on this alone; always scope by aid AND a time window.

hazard.text: RawProcessId is recycled by the OS. Without aid and a tight window this returns unrelated processes.

note: TA joins aid to aidmaster for hostname, domain, OU, site, OS, geo, gateway, MAC.
